subject: ClearVista priority signal + exception request: short-term retention export
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, James Martin <james.martin@clearvista.com>, procurement@clearvista.com
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearVista priority signal + exception request: short-term retention export

Laura —

Quick heads-up on ClearVista (CLV-2027-042). Procurement is asking for a 90-day retention evidence export for the pilot environment by end of next week to close the SOW. James and procurement included here.

Why we need this: their security team requires a short-term historical export to satisfy an internal audit before signing. They will accept a scoped export (pilot namespace only, no PII fields) with an auditable manifest.

Ask: can Product / Eng scope a one-off, auditable retention export (or a scoped retention-window toggle for a single tenant) that we can deliver as a documented export? Ben, Karthik — I flagged the timeline in HubSpot (link below).

Attachments: ClearVista_SOW_v1.pdf, SOC2_evidence_summary.xlsx (procurement asked for both)

HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/CLV-2027-042
Drive: https://drive.company/clearvista/due-diligence

We know this is an exception request — happy to scope it narrowly and accept a timeboxed rollout or manual export if that speeds things up. Procurement needs sign-off by 2027-04-26.

Thanks —
Stephanie
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

--
ClearVista contact: James Martin, Director of Platform (james.martin@clearvista.com)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearVista priority signal + exception request: short-term retention export

Stephanie — thanks for the context and links. Looping in Markus from Eng to triage feasibility.

Quick clarifying Qs for scope (answers will determine engineering effort):
- Do they need a one-time data export (CSV/Parquet) of recent inference logs, or do they want the system to retain logs for 90 days going forward?
- Confirm pilot namespace only and confirm which fields are allowed to be omitted for PII compliance.
- Will they accept a signed manifest + hash checksum for the export (preferred) rather than a live read-only UI?

Markus — can you advise rough T-shirt sizing if we provide: (A) one-time export (pilot namespace, redacted PII), (B) tenant-scoped retention toggle (90d) that’s feature-flagged and auditable, or (C) manual offline export produced by SRE? We need to tell procurement whether this is a few days vs multiple sprints.

If we can get (A) delivered quickly, I recommend we do that as a stop-gap and scope (B) for a sprint one follow-up if the account commits.

Laura
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearVista priority signal + exception request: short-term retention export

Laura / Markus —

Quick follow — procurement just reiterated: they need a packaged, auditable export covering the pilot namespace from 2027-01-01 to 2027-03-31 (90 days) and a brief execution matrix showing who ran the export and the checksum. They said a one-time deliverable is acceptable; they do not want permanent retention.

Timeline constraint: if we can provide the export + manifest by COB 2027-04-26, procurement will sign the SOW and we can move to kickoff. James is copied here to confirm acceptance.

Karthik — I also asked Solutions to check whether the pilot data needs additional redaction. If we can commit to a one-time export and a verification checklist, that's the lowest-risk path.

If Eng can produce (A) one-time export <= 5 dev-days or a scripted SRE export, we can close. Otherwise, we need to escalate.

Thanks —
Ben
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: James Martin <james.martin@clearvista.com>, procurement@clearvista.com
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearVista priority signal + exception request: short-term retention export

Team —

Thanks for the clear scope. Based on the ask (one-time export of pilot namespace logs, redacted PII, with manifest + checksum for 2027-01-01 to 2027-03-31), Eng can deliver an auditable export as a scoped, time-boxed exception. High-level plan: 

1) Implementation path: SRE-scripted export (Parquet) of pilot namespace logs with a post-export signing step (SHA256 manifest). No product changes required for the stop-gap.
2) Estimated effort: 3 dev-days + 1 day of SRE validation and manifest generation (total 4 dev-days). We can do this as an ad-hoc run and hand the artifact to procurement.
3) Compliance notes: we will redact designated PII fields (as listed in SOC2_evidence_summary.xlsx) before packaging. We'll include an execution checklist with operator identity and timestamp.
4) Delivery ETA: execute export on 2027-04-24, validation on 2027-04-25, deliver artifacts to procurement on 2027-04-25 COB. This meets the 2027-04-26 sign-off ask with one buffer day.

Action items:
- Stephanie / Ben: confirm procurement will accept a one-time SRE export (James / procurement on confirm).
- Karthik: validate the redaction list with ClearVista security (CC'd James).
- Laura: please file a follow-up ticket to scope a tenant-scoped retention toggle for sprint planning if ClearVista converts.

If procurement needs a different format (CSV vs Parquet) let us know; Parquet preferred for size and checksums but we can convert. We'll treat this as an exception with clear rollback (no retention policy changes).

-Markus
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
